messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 3259991234 - SLO breach: /v1/stream p95=710ms (SLO=150ms), p99=2.6s (SLO=500ms). Streaming stalls 0.9% across eu-west2. Routing errors spike +12% in last 5m. Paging oncall.
ryan (oncall): on it. looking at dashboards now -> https://console.redwood/dev/dashboards/streaming/slo?range=5m :mag_right:
ryan (oncall): p95 trending up since ~3259989000. any net-eng oncall? @meilin?
meilin (net-eng): I'm here, seeing cross-AZ RTT increase between azb->azc in eu-west2 starting ~10m ago. BGP shows flaps on some egress paths, NAT gateway queue depth high. DNS lookups per request increased slightly.
ben (infra): also seeing conntrack table saturation on routers serving azc, ephemeral port exhaustion on a subset of nat instances. top of stack: streaming clients hang during TLS handshake -> TLS SYN->SYN-ACK delay ~600–1200ms.
ryan (oncall): low-latency customer impact? cs?
eloise (cs): a few customers in EU complaining about slow streaming and partial transcriptions. no total outages but real-time UX degraded for large sessions. sending a quick note to affected accounts.
meilin (net-eng): quick triage: suspect crosszone uplink path via transit nodes -> packet loss ~0.8–1.5% on the path, causing TCP retransmits and handshake stalls. NAT egress queues exacerbate tail.
ben (infra): mitigation options: 1) shift streaming traffic away from azc NATs to azb/aze pools via routing policy, 2) spin up extra NATs in azc (takes ~2-4m), 3) reduce worker parallelism briefly to reduce conntrack.
ryan (oncall): do we have a safe quick action? prefer route-level change first. meilin, can you do an emergency route tweak + short TTL for DNS?
meilin (net-eng): will try policy route to prefer local AZ egress for streaming hostnames. applying route update to weighted policy now.
meilin (net-eng): applying: ```
# set weight to prefer azb/aze for streaming traffic
netctl route update --service streaming --region eu-west2 --prefer-az azb,aze --ttl 30
```
deploy-bot: started job 3259991245 for routing change (runbook: routing-quick-reroute).
meilin (net-eng): route change pushed. monitoring metrics.
ryan (oncall): spinning up 2 nat-xlarge in azc as fallback, will attach to transit if reroute doesn't hold. ben, can you start hosts?
ben (infra): launching nat-xlarge-2/3 in eu-west2-azc now. cloud api show boot 60–90s.
meilin (net-eng): immediate telemetry: packet loss dropped to ~0.2%, TCP retransmits down, TLS handshake p50 ~120ms. p95 moving down.
ryan (oncall): live SLO numbers update: p95 now ~140ms, p99 ~480ms. still slightly above p99 target but < before. streaming stalls down to 0.2%. :thumbsup:
eloise (cs): updating customers: we saw improvement, will follow up when fully stable.
ben (infra): nat instances booted and joined pool. not attaching unless needed.
meilin (net-eng): holding reroute for 30m to stabilize. plan full routing policy rollback if underlying transit nodes show green. filing ticket to escalate to cloud provider for transit path root cause (packet drops).
ryan (oncall): summary for postmortem thread: root cause likely transient packet loss on inter-AZ transit nodes + conntrack pressure on NATs leading to TLS handshake tail amplification. mitigations: emergency weighted reroute to prefer azb/aze, spin up extra NATs as warm standby, reduced worker concurrency not needed after reroute.
meilin (net-eng): followups: 1) provider ticket w/ traceroutes attached, 2) increase conntrack table + ephemeral port capacity across NAT fleet (schedule), 3) evaluate adaptive routing for streaming class to avoid single transit path.
ben (infra): runbook note addition: add quick checklist for emergency-az-preference and nat-warm-standby.
ryan (oncall): will keep thread open for 1h. if stable, send handoff to eng-sre for postmortem. great job team.
eloise (cs): customers notified, escalation cleared for now.
meilin (net-eng): monitoring shows stable for 25m. no further paging expected.
ryan (oncall): closing paging window, will file incident report. tagging incident severity: sev2.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15T16:10Z created (sev2) - ticket #INC-8742.
meilin (net-eng): attaching quick logs and traceroute snippet for postmortem: ```
traceroute to 10.12.45.1 (via transit-node-3)
 1 10.0.1.1 0.8 ms 0.6 ms 0.7 ms
 2 transit-node-3 41.2 ms 39.8 ms 1023.5 ms  <-- intermittent huge RTT
 3 10.12.45.1 42.1 ms 40.3 ms 41.9 ms
```
ryan (oncall): thanks all. postmortem assignee: @ben (infra) + @meilin (net-eng). eloise will handle customer follow-up.
ben (infra): copying action items into SRE backlog now.
ryan (oncall): end of thread for now. will update when postmortem is up.
